rationale: No supported optimization can be applied safely while preserving coverage. The workflow already cancels superseded runs via styfle/cancel-workflow-action in both jobs (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE already satisfied). Matrix fail-fast is GitHub's default (true) and is contraindicated here (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST): all three node-version matrix cells (20, 22, 24) are required to preserve the intended cross-version validation coverage, so cancelling remaining cells on failure would reduce required-check coverage. Dependency caching is already provided by bahmutov/npm-install@v1, so adding a setup-node cache is contraindicated by P-LIT-GHA-CACHE ('An equivalent cache already exists'). P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT cannot be safely applied: the measured experiment evidence used a 5-minute timeout on a ~34-second job, but this repository's valid runs take roughly 6-8 minutes (ci_history), so a 5-minute budget would trigger false timeouts on valid slow runs, violating the pattern's contraindication ('Valid slow runs exceed the proposed limit'); there is no per-job duration history to establish a safe custom budget, and a loose timeout would not yield measured savings on normal runs. Other patterns (test/build selection, scheduling, environment reuse) are either contraindicated by required-check semantics or not applicable to this push/PR workflow.
